problem: A B2B SaaS founder or marketer cannot tell whether the AI crawlers behind ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity can actually reach and read their website while a competitor's is fully readable; this skill audits both live as each crawler and returns an evidence-backed gap report plus draft llms.txt, robots.txt patch and Studio handoff.

skills.role: Audit your site and competitors as each AI crawler, then report the readiness gap with evidence and draft the fixes
